rev: LLC-12 (REV 12/2022), with the Submission Cover Sheet (REV 03/2024)
notes: Answers: addresses are 'street, city, ST ZIP' and split into the form's boxes (4c's and 6b's state is printed as CA). manager and agent take an individual's full name (first, middle and last go in their boxes) or an entity's name (recognized by Inc., LLC, Corp., Services and the like, it goes in 5b or 6c instead). entity_number is written digits only. 'None' leaves an optional line blank (jurisdiction for a California LLC, mailing, California office, the agent's address for a corporate agent, CEO, email). Additional managers or members go on Form LLC-12A, which isn't filled here. The cover sheet's comments, the date, and the signature are left for the signer.
